user_questions.question: Which app and customer record is meant? Options: (A) the external Pronto consumer mobile/web app, customers as Contact matched by Contact.Pronto_App_Account_Id__c (recommended; populated on 198/198 Contacts, no community users); (B) the Customer Support Experience Cloud site (UnderConstruction, 0 customer users); (C) internal Salesforce users recording favourites for customers. Also: should a customer be able to favourite the same storefront more than once?
user_questions.simulated_answer: Junction object Favorite Storefront (Contact, Storefront), unique pair. (No preference on the app connection; use your recommended default.)

skill_friction: The requirement's 'the app' names an external system; SKILL.md says 'how to connect is implementation' once a platform is named, but does not say whether an integration user / OAuth client that does not exist is a blocking setup step versus an ask; spec-format's line about integration users being Setup steps settled it, but only after reading spec-format.

The 'after two wrong AskCoworker claims, verify every kept fact' rule is clear, but platform claims (cascade delete hard-delete, Delete without Edit) are untestable with the allowed commands; the fallback 'documented behavior' is fine but it's unclear whether they count toward the two-claim threshold when they come from I/R/T proposals rather than facts.

Spec-format guidance on FlowTest does not address record-triggered flows whose initial record needs org-specific parent Ids (master-detail); I chose manual checks, but the rule 'Add a Flow Test row only when it can assert the main outcome' suggested a FlowTest row.

The R split rule ('for more than 8 changes... split R') didn't apply (6 rows) yet the full R still timed out; the retry table handled it, but the template could suggest splitting R by default when the established-facts list is long.
